outcome.primary_filter: Fltr.SetGood==TRUE after lossless clean CSV parsing

features.numeric_preprocessing: finite source values; mean and population standard deviation fitted separately on each corresponding training pool; zero variance maps to scale 1
features.categorical_preprocessing: training-only frequency selection of at most 15 observed levels plus one other/unknown level per field

univariate.estimator: standardized least squares on one original numeric field
univariate.direction_and_coefficient: fitted on each corresponding training pool; no test-derived sign constraint

ridge.estimator: Ridge with LSQR on the complete controlled feature arm

histgb.estimator: HistGradientBoostingRegressor on the complete controlled feature arm
histgb.early_stopping_scope: corresponding fit-training rows only; outer test is never used

selection.inner_validation_role: candidate selection using all four frozen inner folds
selection.criterion: minimum mean inner RMSE on log1p Count.Prot; higher mean inner Spearman then canonical config JSON break ties
selection.final_refit: selected configuration refitted on the complete outer-training pool

metrics.top_decile: k=ceil(n/10); mean observed Count.Prot in the highest-predicted k rows divided by mean observed Count.Prot in all rows; prediction ties use clean row order

outputs.directory_creation: exclusive; an existing output directory is fatal
outputs.predictions_granularity: one row per outer-test clean row per model

limitations: Development benchmark only; this is not untouched evaluation, mechanism evidence, protein OOD, or a SOTA claim.
Only the observed Gene-grouped N-terminal fragment construct geometry is evaluated.
Raw and lossless clean historical assets remain unfiltered; the SetGood restriction applies only to this baseline analysis after input parsing.
Synthetic tests establish software behavior only and are not Goodman performance results.
